comments.content:
right now there are basically just emag, sleepy pen, and revolver, none of
which are all that interesting

here are some more ideas:
"someone else's prints" gloves - when you touch things, other peoples'
prints get on them - possibly the gloves are undetectable?
speech synthesizer - so you can pretend to be someone else over the radio
magic bomb juice - add to a bomb, it's more powerful!
Radio disruptor: Disrupts inbound/outbound radio transmissions in a 2-4 tile radius

Retrovirus pill: feed this to a person to instantly turn them into a monkey, which 
can bite other people and make THEM monkeys, etc.

Disguise kit: When used on a dead person can change the traitors identity completely
to that of the victim. One use only.

Every except the fingerprints, speech synthesizer and radio disruptor are extremely
overpowered (fingerprints would be, except it rarely pops up). Speech synthesizer
could work with a given fail rate. Radio disruptor would be very useful and not
overpowered given a short charge (maybe 30 seconds off a single power cell?)
